correctness.rationale: Forced ordered disjoint boundary edges in C_{2n} number k!·(2n/(2n−k))binom(2n−k,k), occur with probability reciprocal of consecutive odd factors; they never cross remaining chords. Deletion leaves a uniform smaller cyclic matching, proving E[(S)_k f(X_n)]=a_{n,k} E[f(X_{n−k})] for all f. First mixed moments plus established crossing mean/variance give Cov(X,S)=−2n(n−1)/(3(2n−1)) and Corr=−√(5/(n+3)). E(S)_k≤2^k gives dominated expansion of mixed characteristic/PGF transforms; known crossing CLT yields independent N(0,1) and Poisson(1). Independently enumerated all labeled perfect matchings through n=6 (10,395 at n=6) and confirmed exact joint moments. Boundary n=2 and cyclic wraparound counted; finite enumeration not CLT proof.
